note: PATCH: BUG-133 tightens rotation-matrix admission to the measured Creo 10 kernel boundary. A live sweep placed 9/8/7-decimal 28-degree matrices with residuals 4.5e-10, 7.664e-9 and 4.7552320081578614e-8, while 2.241e-7, 4.890e-7 and 1.1294880000178864e-6 were rejected by both ProAsmcompAssemble and ProAsmcompPositionSet with code -2. ADMISSION_TOLERANCE and MAX_ADMISSION_TOLERANCE are both 1e-7 in Python and the native helper, so an explicit rotation_tolerance can only tighten; six-decimal matrices now fail before a job exists with the residual quoted, and seven-decimal or exact matrices are echoed verbatim without repair, transpose or reorthogonalization. 1e-9 remains a classification-only threshold for strict/near_orthonormal. Public tools stay at 110. Not verified: other Creo versions and the WorkBuddy black box.
